Existing admission-condition ownership is required for typed attribution; unknown/unlocked/prior-gap paths stay UNKNOWN with null correlation.

Request correlation requires the retained original carrier/token/binding, current task/loop/thread/process context, original middleware/downstream/scope and finite existing row identity/sequences. Foreign/copied carrier bindings cannot become the current request; no latest-row inference is used.
